question: A concave mirror generally forms real images. However, under a specific condition, it functions as a 'magnifying glass' producing a virtual and erect image. What is the position of the object relative to the mirror for this to occur?

options.A: Placed exactly at the centre of curvature ($C$).
options.B: Placed between the centre of curvature ($C$) and the focus ($F$).
options.C: Placed between the pole ($P$) and the principal focus ($F$).
options.D: Placed beyond the centre of curvature ($C$).
